verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Someone left the porch light burning through the night —
now the sparrows argue in its useless glow.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A kettle ticks as it cools on the stove —
no one left to pour the second cup.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I fold the letter twice, then twice again —
still it won't fit back in its envelope.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
The words blur where my thumb keeps pressing down —
some ink was never meant to stay put.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Rain finds the gap I patched last autumn —
the roof learns my mistakes before I do.

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
A moth keeps circling the porch light —
some hungers never learn from the burn.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
The clerk stamps my form without looking up —
another day filed under someone else's name.
